mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) as totalCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN MONITOR_STATUS = 'NORMAL' THEN 1 END) as normalCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN MONITOR_STATUS = 'WARNING' THEN 1 END) as warningCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN MONITOR_STATUS = 'CRITICAL' THEN 1 END) as criticalCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN MONITOR_STATUS = 'ERROR' THEN 1 END) as errorCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN PROCESS_STATUS = 'PENDING' THEN 1 END) as pendingCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN PROCESS_STATUS = 'RESOLVED' THEN 1 END) as resolvedCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN ALERT_LEVEL IN ('HIGH', 'CRITICAL') THEN 1 END) as highPriorityCount FROM SYS_MONITOR WHERE
DATE(MONITOR_TIME) = CURDATE()
TRUNC(MONITOR_TIME) = TRUNC(SYSDATE)

SELECT MONITOR_TYPE as typeName, COUNT(*) as count, COUNT(CASE WHEN MONITOR_STATUS != 'NORMAL' THEN 1 END) as alertCount FROM SYS_MONITOR WHERE
DATE(MONITOR_TIME) >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)
TRUNC(MONITOR_TIME) >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) - 7
GROUP BY MONITOR_TYPE ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT MONITOR_STATUS as statusName, COUNT(*) as count, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SYS_MONITOR WHERE
DATE(MONITOR_TIME) >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)
TRUNC(MONITOR_TIME) >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) - 7
), 2) as percentage FROM SYS_MONITOR WHERE
DATE(MONITOR_TIME) >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)
TRUNC(MONITOR_TIME) >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) - 7
GROUP BY MONITOR_STATUS ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT ALERT_LEVEL as levelName, COUNT(*) as count FROM SYS_MONITOR WHERE MONITOR_STATUS != 'NORMAL' AND
DATE(MONITOR_TIME) >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)
TRUNC(MONITOR_TIME) >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) - 7
GROUP BY ALERT_LEVEL ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT SERVER_IP as serverIp, SERVER_NAME as serverName, COUNT(*) as count, COUNT(CASE WHEN MONITOR_STATUS != 'NORMAL' THEN 1 END) as alertCount FROM SYS_MONITOR WHERE SERVER_IP IS NOT NULL AND
DATE(MONITOR_TIME) >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
TRUNC(MONITOR_TIME) >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) - 1
GROUP BY SERVER_IP, SERVER_NAME ORDER BY alertCount DESC, count DESC

SELECT APPLICATION_NAME as applicationName, COUNT(*) as count, COUNT(CASE WHEN MONITOR_STATUS != 'NORMAL' THEN 1 END) as alertCount FROM SYS_MONITOR WHERE APPLICATION_NAME IS NOT NULL AND
DATE(MONITOR_TIME) >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
TRUNC(MONITOR_TIME) >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) - 1
GROUP BY APPLICATION_NAME ORDER BY alertCount DESC, count DESC

SELECT
DATE(MONITOR_TIME) as monitorDate,
TO_CHAR(MONITOR_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as monitorDate,
COUNT(*) as totalCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN MONITOR_STATUS = 'NORMAL' THEN 1 END) as normalCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN MONITOR_STATUS != 'NORMAL' THEN 1 END) as alertCount FROM SYS_MONITOR
AND DATE(MONITOR_TIME) >= #{startDate}
AND TRUNC(MONITOR_TIME) >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND DATE(MONITOR_TIME) <= #{endDate}
AND TRUNC(MONITOR_TIME) <= TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
GROUP BY DATE(MONITOR_TIME) ORDER BY DATE(MONITOR_TIME) ASC
GROUP BY TO_CHAR(MONITOR_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD') ORDER BY TO_CHAR(MONITOR_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD') ASC

SELECT
DATE(MONITOR_TIME) as alertDate,
TO_CHAR(MONITOR_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as alertDate,
COUNT(*) as alertCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN ALERT_LEVEL = 'CRITICAL' THEN 1 END) as criticalCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN ALERT_LEVEL = 'HIGH' THEN 1 END) as highCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN ALERT_LEVEL = 'MEDIUM' THEN 1 END) as mediumCount FROM SYS_MONITOR WHERE MONITOR_STATUS != 'NORMAL'
AND DATE(MONITOR_TIME) >= #{startDate}
AND TRUNC(MONITOR_TIME) >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND DATE(MONITOR_TIME) <= #{endDate}
AND TRUNC(MONITOR_TIME) <= TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
GROUP BY DATE(MONITOR_TIME) ORDER BY DATE(MONITOR_TIME) ASC
GROUP BY TO_CHAR(MONITOR_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD') ORDER BY TO_CHAR(MONITOR_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD') ASC

SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN MONITOR_TYPE = 'PERFORMANCE' AND MONITOR_ITEM = 'CPU_USAGE' THEN CAST(MONITOR_VALUE AS DECIMAL(10,2)) END) as avgCpuUsage, AVG(CASE WHEN MONITOR_TYPE = 'PERFORMANCE' AND MONITOR_ITEM = 'MEMORY_USAGE' THEN CAST(MONITOR_VALUE AS DECIMAL(10,2)) END) as avgMemoryUsage, AVG(CASE WHEN MONITOR_TYPE = 'PERFORMANCE' AND MONITOR_ITEM = 'DISK_USAGE' THEN CAST(MONITOR_VALUE AS DECIMAL(10,2)) END) as avgDiskUsage, MAX(CASE WHEN MONITOR_TYPE = 'PERFORMANCE' AND MONITOR_ITEM = 'CPU_USAGE' THEN CAST(MONITOR_VALUE AS DECIMAL(10,2)) END) as maxCpuUsage, MAX(CASE WHEN MONITOR_TYPE = 'PERFORMANCE' AND MONITOR_ITEM = 'MEMORY_USAGE' THEN CAST(MONITOR_VALUE AS DECIMAL(10,2)) END) as maxMemoryUsage, MAX(CASE WHEN MONITOR_TYPE = 'PERFORMANCE' AND MONITOR_ITEM = 'DISK_USAGE' THEN CAST(MONITOR_VALUE AS DECIMAL(10,2)) END) as maxDiskUsage FROM SYS_MONITOR WHERE MONITOR_TYPE = 'PERFORMANCE' AND
DATE(MONITOR_TIME) = CURDATE()
TRUNC(MONITOR_TIME) = TRUNC(SYSDATE)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT SERVER_IP) as totalServers, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN MONITOR_STATUS = 'NORMAL' THEN SERVER_IP END) as healthyServers, COUNT(DISTINCT APPLICATION_NAME) as totalApplications, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN MONITOR_STATUS = 'NORMAL' THEN APPLICATION_NAME END) as healthyApplications, ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN MONITOR_STATUS = 'NORMAL' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) as healthPercentage FROM SYS_MONITOR WHERE
MONITOR_TIME >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 HOUR)
MONITOR_TIME >= SYSDATE - 1/24
SELECT DISTINCT MONITOR_ITEM FROM SYS_MONITOR WHERE MONITOR_TYPE = #{monitorType} ORDER BY MONITOR_ITEM
SELECT DISTINCT SERVER_IP as serverIp, SERVER_NAME as serverName FROM SYS_MONITOR WHERE SERVER_IP IS NOT NULL ORDER BY SERVER_IP
SELECT DISTINCT APPLICATION_NAME as applicationName FROM SYS_MONITOR WHERE APPLICATION_NAME IS NOT NULL ORDER BY APPLICATION_NAME
